title: chat.device.revoked payload (v1)
description: Emitted when a linked device is revoked; consumers invalidate device-bound sessions, delivery targets, and key state. Identifier-level metadata only. Envelope contract: aggregate_type 'device', aggregate_id 'device_id', aggregate_version 2 (the revocation is the second and latest version of the device aggregate after registration with version 1).

device_id.description: Server-assigned device record ID; soft reference to chat_db.chat_devices.id.

user_id.description: Device owner; soft reference to chat_db.chat_users.id.
